allowed_conclusion: If the new wrapper execution passes, describe exact parsed scientific-content and verified-binding replay, not byte-exact reproduction.
checks: The temporary tree receives copies of the experiment and declared inputs; original scientific files are not rewritten by the wrapper.
The unchanged primary and independent validator execute in the temporary tree; their existing code/input/LOCK checks remain active.
All FAMILIES, RESULT and six CERT artifacts are compared as parsed JSON. Dictionary ordering is ignored, while list/array ordering remains significant.
Each original and fresh VALIDATION receipt first verifies its own validator, LOCK, source-envelope and output byte hashes.
Only explicit result/family/certificate output-reference pins are replaced by canonical JSON-content hashes; source/code/LOCK pins are not normalized.
The complete normalized receipts are compared, preserving decisions, bounds, witnesses and all other fields. Canonical output-content hashes also retain JSON scalar types.
Byte equality is reported separately rather than assumed or relabeled as success.
limitations: This wrapper was added after the byte replay failed and is an engineering reproduction check, not a new scientific test or a replacement original PASS.
Canonical comparison must not be used to edit or overwrite original locked certificates/results.
Dictionary ordering from legacy set iteration is a plausible cause of byte differences; the content comparison, rather than that explanation alone, determines whether scientific content agrees.
No meanings, alphabet identification, source compatibility upgrade or new native analysis follows.
reviewer_execution: No replay rerun and no code edits; this is an independent source review of the new engineering wrapper.
